+package report
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	trivyTypes "github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/pkg/types"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/models"
+)
+
+func TestFormatFullPlainTextKeepsLibraryPaths(t *testing.T) {
+	first := "/first/Pipfile.lock"
+	second := "/second/Pipfile.lock"
+	r := models.ScanResult{
+		ServerName: "local",
+		LibraryScanners: models.LibraryScanners{
+			{Path: first, Libs: []trivyTypes.Library{{Name: "shared", Version: "1.0.0"}}},
+			{Path: second, Libs: []trivyTypes.Library{{Name: "shared", Version: "2.0.0"}}},
+		},
+		ScannedCves: models.VulnInfos{
+			"CVE-2020-0001": {
+				CveID: "CVE-2020-0001",
+				CveContents: models.NewCveContents(models.CveContent{
+					Type: models.Trivy, CveID: "CVE-2020-0001", Summary: "Shared library vulnerability",
+				}),
+				LibraryFixedIns: models.LibraryFixedIns{
+					{Key: "python", Name: "shared", Path: first, FixedIn: "3.0.0"},
+					{Key: "python", Name: "shared", Path: second},
+				},
+			},
+		},
+	}
+
+	out := formatFullPlainText(r)
+	for _, want := range []string{
+		"shared-1.0.0, FixedIn: 3.0.0 (" + first + ")",
+		"shared-2.0.0 (" + second + ")",
+	} {
+		if strings.Count(out, want) != 1 {
+			t.Errorf("report should contain %q once:\n%s", want, out)
+		}
+	}
+	if strings.Contains(out, "shared-1.0.0 ("+second+")") ||
+		strings.Contains(out, "shared-2.0.0 ("+first+")") ||
+		strings.Contains(out, "shared-2.0.0, FixedIn:") {
+		t.Errorf("report mixed lockfile details:\n%s", out)
+	}
+}

+package scan
+
+import (
+	"io/ioutil"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+)
+
+func TestScanLibrariesKeepsLockfilesSeparate(t *testing.T) {
+	root, err := ioutil.TempDir("", "vuls-lockfiles-")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer os.RemoveAll(root)
+
+	paths := []string{
+		filepath.Join(root, "first", "Pipfile.lock"),
+		filepath.Join(root, "second", "Pipfile.lock"),
+	}
+	versions := []string{"1.0.0", "2.0.0"}
+	for i, path := range paths {
+		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0700); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		content := []byte(`{"default":{"shared":{"version":"==` + versions[i] + `"}}}`)
+		if err := ioutil.WriteFile(path, content, 0600); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+
+	scanner := base{ServerInfo: config.ServerInfo{
+		Host:      "localhost",
+		Port:      "local",
+		Lockfiles: []string{paths[0], paths[1], paths[0]},
+	}}
+	if err := scanner.scanLibraries(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if len(scanner.LibraryScanners) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d library scanners, want 2", len(scanner.LibraryScanners))
+	}
+	for i, path := range paths {
+		libs := scanner.LibraryScanners.Find(path, "shared")
+		if len(libs) != 1 || libs[path].Version != versions[i] {
+			t.Errorf("libraries for %s = %v, want shared %s", path, libs, versions[i])
+		}
+	}
+}
